edgeClassification.statuses: named (root C13, or accepted by name in the v04 bounded disposition: see source), granted, contact, screen, faceted-round, proposed; first matching set wins; an unmatched hard edge is undeclared (a failure)
edgeClassification.bevelLength: bevelMiddleSeamM in edge_tally(): the seam between the two faces of a 2-segment bevel, not the treated original edge length
